title: Simple Bouguer gravity map of Cross Hill quadrangle
citation: Lawrence, D.P., and Chalcraft, R.G., 1984, Simple Bouguer gravity map of Cross Hill quadrangle: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-36, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-36 (Lawrence and Chalcraft, 1984), simple Bouguer gravity map of the Cross Hill quadrangle, 1:24,000: gravity contours at one-milligal intervals and gravity stations on the topographic base. No geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other single-sheet Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
